before.requirement: Rejection of explicit (?C) callouts through PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT with error 203 was not a supported behavior before this change.
before.reason: The before-version extra-option mask lacks the bit, and its complete callout parser proceeds directly to parsing the callout without the new rejection guard.

after.requirement: Compilation can select PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT and reject explicit (?C) callout syntax with error 203.
after.reason: The after-version parser checks the new compile-context bit and returns ERR103. The fixed target only sets a compiled-length limit on that context, so generated input cannot enable this behavior.

source_evidence.quote:
PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT
If this option is set, PCRE2 treats callouts in the pattern as a syntax error, returning PCRE2_ERROR_CALLOUT_CALLER_DISABLED. This is useful if the application knows that a callout will not be provided to pcre2_match(), so that callouts in the pattern are not silently ignored.
